name: use-view-transition
title: useViewTransition / startViewTransition
description: Run a React state change inside a View Transition — flushSync inside the snapshot, a plain update where the API is missing or the user asked for reduced motion, and an optional skip while one is already running.

meta.whenToUse: An in-page state change should cross-fade or morph instead of jumping — switching a view, reordering, opening a detail pane.
meta.whenNotToUse: A component's own enter/exit (use Base UI's lifecycle styles or the motion-* utilities), or anything that must animate in every browser.
